reference.citation: Tsallis C (1988). Possible generalization of Boltzmann-Gibbs statistics. J Stat Phys 52(1-2):479-487. Reference impl: NeuroKit2 entropy_tsallis (Makowski et al. 2021). Data: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the Tsallis entropy with NeuroKit2 entropy_tsallis across q = {0.5, 1, 2, 3} on the identical amplitude histogram and contrasts it with the Renyi entropy; reports the collision (q=2) and Shannon (q=1) Tsallis entropies, the bit-exact NeuroKit2 agreement, the divergence from Renyi at q=2, the agreement with Renyi at q=1, and the monotonicity
